THE PROBLEM

AI conversations today are… boring.

  • × One-on-one chatbots with no personality or conflict
  • × Users type — they never watch
  • × No social experience — AI is isolating
  • × Zero audience participation or shared moments
  • × No entertainment layer on top of intelligence

THE SOLUTION

A live debate arena powered by Napster's Companion API

  • ✓ Multiple AI agents debate autonomously in real-time
  • ✓ Each agent has a distinct personality, voice, and visual avatar
  • ✓ Audiences watch together — same debate, same audio, same chaos
  • ✓ Viewers inject chaos rules, change topics, and cast votes
  • ✓ Think: cable news war room meets late-night panel comedy

BUILT TO SURVIVE

Auto-recovery keeps the show running 24/7

WATCHDOG

Detects dead sessions — 3 consecutive force-advances or 2 minutes of silence triggers automatic recovery with a fresh topic.

TURN MANAGEMENT

Client-assisted, server-fallback turn tracking. Three-flag system (text, talk, audio) ensures clean handoffs between agents.

CONTENT MODERATION

Hybrid blocklist + OpenAI moderation API. Leetspeak normalization catches creative bypasses. All viewer input filtered.

GRACEFUL DEGRADATION

15s no-response timeout per agent. Automatic topic rotation every 5 minutes. Fisher-Yates shuffle prevents repeats.
